title: Evaluation of the Impact of a Strategy of Perioperative NSAID Suppression in Patients Undergoing Video-assisted Thoracic Surgery (VATS) on the Presence of Chronic Postoperative Pain (CPOP): a Randomised Clinical Trial- EVADRAINS
official: Evaluation of the Impact of a Strategy of Perioperative NSAID Suppression in Patients Undergoing Video-assisted Thoracic Surgery (VATS) on the Presence of Chronic Postoperative Pain (CPOP): a Randomised Clinical Trial (EVADRAINS)
summary: Main objective: The primary objective of this study is to assess the impact of a strategy to discontinue NSAIDs during the perioperative period on the development of chronic postoperative pain three months after video-assisted thoracoscopic surgery

interventions.name: KETOPROFENE AGUETTANT 100 mg, solution pour perfusion
KETOPROFENE MEDISOL 100 mg/4 ml, solution à diluer pour perfusion

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. -	Adult patients aged 18 to 75
2. -	Patients scheduled for video-assisted thoracic surgery
3. -	Able to give informed consent to participate in the study
4. -	Affiliated to a social health insurance scheme
Exclusion criteria:
1. -	History of renal insufficiency (GFR <60 mL/min/1.73m2)
2. Incapacitated subject (subject to a legal protection measure: safeguard of justice, curatorship, guardianship, future protection mandate, family habilitation)
3. -	 Pregnant or breast-feeding
4. -	Surgical contraindications to NSAIDs (talc surgery)
5. -	Contraindications to NSAIDs
6. -	Diabetes, active cancer other than lung cancer currently being treated
7. -	Heart rhythm disorder, pacemaker in place
8. -	History of pain, regardless of pain type or anatomical site, lasting 3 months or longer during the year preceding surgery, as defined by the International Association for the Study of Pain (IASP) (5).
9. -	History of treatment with steroidal or non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (SAIDs or NSAIDs) within the 3 months preceding surgery.
10. -	History of gastric or duodenal ulcer
11. -	Peripheral artery disease > stage 2
12. -	Active inflammatory diseases currently being treated
13. -	History of opioid therapy within the 3 months preceding surgery or continuous opioid use for more than 3 months during the year preceding surgery.
14. -	 Urgent surgery;
15. -	Contraindication to 0.9% NaCl and the excipients in the placebo
16. -	Scheduled hospitalization during the study period
17. Participation in another interventional drug clinical trial.
18. Impossibility of giving the subject informed information in the event of difficulties in understanding the subject
